metadata.title: Surrealist Pop Portrait with Liquid Elements

retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist composition featuring a high-contrast partial portrait integrated with a stylized landscape and floating liquid orbs.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition framed by a thick red border, featuring a high-contrast, partially cropped male portrait on the left. The background consists of a deep blue sky with dark, streaky clouds and a pink-toned mountain range at the bottom. Floating blue liquid bubbles emerge from the figure's head, creating a sense of fluid motion.
coreVisualRelationships: Partial portrait anchored to the left edge
Floating liquid orbs connecting the subject to the sky
High-contrast subject against a saturated landscape
Thick solid border framing the entire scene
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white facial features with flat skin tones
Floating blue liquid droplets with highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a large-scale, vertically cropped portrait occupying the left third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face acts as the primary anchor, balanced by the text and logo in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the face, follows the trail of blue bubbles upward and across the sky to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky provides significant negative space, allowing the floating elements to stand out.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue sky and red border
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright cyan for liquid bubbles and pale yellow for the shirt
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border and sky contrasted with muted pink mountains and flat yellow clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a brush or marker
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders and ascenders that blend into the background elements
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single organic script paired with a circular graphic emblem.
graphicDevices: Horizontal color bands in the sky

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, informal nature of the original lettering.
Captures the consistent stroke width and organic curves.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal landscape with a thick red border. On the left, a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man with a beard, cropped vertically. The background is a deep blue sky with dark clouds and pink mountains at the bottom. Add floating cyan liquid bubbles emerging from the man's head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered script in the top right corner using a white or pale yellow color, ensuring it feels integrated with the sky.

verificationChecks: Is the red border thick and solid?
Are the liquid bubbles cyan and floating?
Is the portrait high-contrast and cropped on the left?
Is the typography a fluid, handwritten script?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific logo design in the top right
postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the red border.
Ensure the portrait is correctly positioned on the left.
Verify the liquid bubbles have a glossy, highlighted appearance.
Confirm the sky has a layered, streaky texture.
Check that the typography is legible but organic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast partial portrait with a surreal landscape, linked by floating fluid elements and framed by a bold primary-colored border.
